newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF revises down Nov trade surplus figure.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF revises down Nov trade surplus figure.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance said on Thursday it had revised down customs-cleared trade figures for November to a surplus of 670.77 billion yen, a fall of 0.4 percent from a year earlier.
The preliminary figures, announced on December 18, showed a 0.2 percent rise in the surplus to 675.19 billion yen in November, which the ministry had said was the first rise in 24 months.

December trade figures released earlier on Thursday showed a 20.6 percent drop in the surplus from the previous year. It was the 25th consecutive month of decline in the surplus on a year-on-year basis, the ministry said.
